final: SELECT client.client_id, account.account_id FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account ON district.district_id = account.district_id AND disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE district.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) BETWEEN '1983' AND '1987'
